title: Flipping for Christmas
description: It's almost Christmas when busy realtor Abigail agrees to help her sister with the simple flip of a recently inherited home. Unfortunately, co-beneficiary Bo has other plans in mind.

description: Lucy Lovett wakes up holding a wedding dress and assumes she is about to marry the love her life, Zach Callahan.

description: Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, the pair reunite in the small Texas town of Fern where they must team up to save the town's Christmas Roundup.

title: Jingle Around the Clock
description: Elle decides to reunite her friends for Christmas, but her plans are thwarted by an opportunity at work. She's forced to team up with Max, who has a different take on the holidays. As they work together, they find themselves falling for each other.

title: Holiday Hotline
description: After leaving London, Abby works for a cooking hotline and connects with an anonymous caller, a single father who Abby is unknowingly smitten with in real life.
